create.name: Blue Cliff Monastery
create.bio:
Blue Cliff Monastery is a practice centre and monastic training community of the Plum Village tradition, founded by the Vietnamese Zen teacher Thich Nhat Hanh and set in woodland at Pine Bush in New York's Hudson Valley. Monks and nuns live there year round and share their daily rhythm of sitting and walking meditation, working meditation, mindful meals and Dharma talks with visitors, with a teaching that joins meditation to everyday life and to care for the wider world.

On most Thursdays and Sundays the monastery holds a Day of Mindfulness that anyone may join without registering, on a donation basis. Guests can also book seasonal stays of two nights or more with the resident community, priced on a sliding scale, and the calendar includes themed retreats for families, young adults, Vietnamese speakers and people of colour, a winter retreat and a New Year retreat. The YouTube channel, opened in 2020, streams and keeps the Sunday Dharma talks and question-and-answer sessions with the monastics, in English and Vietnamese, along with talks from the themed retreats.

courses.title: Holiday Retreat 2026-2027: Happiness Is Here and Now
courses.description: The monastery's annual New Year retreat, built around mindful breathing, walking, eating and deep relaxation, on the theme that happiness is available in the present moment.

courses.title: Seasonal retreats (overnight stays)
courses.description: Stays of two to fourteen nights, starting on a Friday, joining the monastics' daily schedule; meals included, with sliding-scale nightly rates by age and lodging.

free_resources.title: Days of Mindfulness
free_resources.description: Open days on most Thursdays and Sundays with meditation, a Dharma talk and a mindful lunch; no registration, donations requested.
